programme.title: Empire with David Olusoga
programme.desc: David Olusoga reveals how the movement of people around the empire – both voluntary and involuntary – continues to shape today's world. The great migrations of the last 300 years were driven by the British Empire. Enslaved Africans were trafficked across the Atlantic to British colonies. And convicts from Britain and Ireland were dispatched to the new territory of Australia.

Indians who signed up to the indenture system were sent to work in the Caribbean, Africa and south east India. And convicts from Britain and Ireland were dispatched to the new territory of Australia.

programme.title: Big Cats 24/7
programme.desc: Under attack from intruder male lions, the mums with young cubs must find the pride.

programme.title: Big Cats 24/7
programme.desc: Reunited to protect themselves from intruding male lions, the Xudum pride mums now struggle to feed so many mouths. Tsebe has four cubs, and her smallest is close to starving. When he becomes injured and then lost, his life is on a knife edge. The flood is now at its fullest, and the team discovers more and more dangerous male leopards pushing into the area. Leopard mum Lediba must find new hiding places to keep her cub safe, while a surprising ally emerges. And cheetah mum Pobe confronts leopards face to face in a bid to protect her family.

programme.title: Alaskan armoilla
programme.desc: Alaskans must confront their past while conquering the present to survive the darkest, coldest part of winter.

programme.title: Ben Fogle's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Ben journeys from Stroma, inhabited 1,000 years ago, to Swona, its first inhabitants being the Vikings and then to the towering prehistoric cliffs of St Kilda, the most remote of Scotland's Lost Worlds.

programme.title: Astronauts: Do You Have What It Takes?
programme.desc: The remaining astronaut candidates face a simulated emergency splashdown where they have to escape from an underwater capsule. Later, a social event gives the panel a chance to scrutinise the candidates' characters. Not all of them make the grade.

programme.title: Tappavat sääilmiöt
programme.desc: Rescuers work to free a young girl that has been trapped under debris after a Turkish earthquake; a father and his daughter race to escape wildfires in Oregon.
